title: Existence of the prescribed derived signed-line comparison
statement: Fix the same finite coefficient setting, levels, scheme, and normalized ordinary signed-line family as in lem-pur-finite-tensor-line-derived-existence. For every integer r, there exists an isomorphism whose image under the actual scalar-adjunction hom bijection is the prescribed fixed-scalar single-complex arrow. This is the existence component only; uniqueness is separate.

source.place: Proof Step 2: ordinary signed-line scalar transpose and derived single-complex calculation.

proof.text: Use local freeness of the signed source line and the normalized ordinary scalar transpose to construct the comparison on a trivializing cover. The local maps glue by the balancing, tensor, and dual-evaluation equations; exact restriction and the fixed-scalar realization transport the resulting degree-zero map, and localization of the single complex yields the displayed HEq equation.

proof_origin: H2, 2026-10-26: split the existence component from the parent unique-comparison statement; the parent proof combines this witness with adjunction injectivity. J2 changes only the computational representation of the complete original HEq predicate: Pointwise for the actual finiteTensorLineComparisonData expands to the same actual adjunction hom equivalence and full original single-functor/restriction composite. No mathematical statement or hypothesis changes.

theorem exists_finiteTensorLineDerivedComparison (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ P.level) (T : Scheme.{u})
    [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (c : P.FiniteTensorLineMaps m hm hmn T)
    (hc : P.FiniteTensorLineMapsNormalized m hm hmn T c) (r : ℤ) :
    ∃ b : (P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn T).obj (P.finiteTensorFixedLine T r) ≅
        (P.finiteReductionSetting m hm).finiteTensorFixedLine T r,
      (P.finiteTensorLineComparisonData m hm hmn T).Pointwise c r b
